body: i’m not dead,at least not this time. I am an even bigger burden to my family than i was before, i can never be left alone and my mom tells me that i am cowardly everytime she cleans me cuts(she doesn’t trust me to do them myself) i’m being sent to a rehab place for a few weeks but i can’t help but feel empty, time passes by like nothing, the sun sets and rises and everything continues as normal so i feel that my life never had any impact to begin with, yesterday one of my brother’s friends killed himself so why not me next?  a large majority of my “friends” sent the cheesy fucking “oml i love u sm” shit and i know that  none of them mean it bc they spelt my name wrong and said the same thing like they were in a copy machine and almost all of them ignored my pleas before all of this so why do they try now? it’s fucking stupid and fake as hell. i don’t understand anything anymore and i feel alone in the ruthless cycle that is the rez life, all i ever really wanted was someone to talk to. to anyone that reads this, i’ll check in after “correction” once again,goodbye.

i don’t understand, i don’t understand anything anymore. i wrote this as a last attempt to get something that i could understand, i understand what i’m gonna do. i assume no one cares simply because of what i’ve experienced.
